facts.pledging: A young woman (left) and a young man (right) stand facing each other, holding out their cup-bearing hands to each other.
facts.caduceus-lion: Above the two float a staff wound with two snakes and the head of a red lion with wings.
facts.wreaths: The woman wears a wreath of green leaves, and the man a wreath of red flowers.
facts.clothes: The woman wears white with a blue cloak, and the man a short patterned tunic.
facts.house-hill: On a green hill behind them is a house with a red roof.
facts.blue-sky: The background is a pale blue sky.

glosses.caduceus-lion: A force that watches over the union of the two; attraction and healing.
glosses.wreaths: An equal place, each wearing a wreath of their own.

reversedGloss.blocked: The feeling is there, but the flow of giving and receiving is blocked.
reversedGloss.internalized: A time when reconciliation with yourself is needed before the relationship.

misdescriptions.wrong: The two are embracing or kissing.
